title: Spec § 13 still writes `Core\Test` as one table cell, and `Core\Test\Response` has no row of its own.
text: Goal `test-request` promised to turn the `Core\Test` row of `docs/spec/01-core-library.md:1017` into a bullet shaped like § 15's, with each member written out, and to give `Core\Test\Response` its own row. The row is still one cell with the response members written inline. The coverage gate at `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/spec_registry_coverage.rs` stays excluded for § 13 on purpose. Closing this rewrites the row and adds the `Core\Test\Response` row, and leaves the gate as it is.
